articles.title: South African airline defends dramatic low-level flyby before rugby union clash
articles.description:
Cape Town stunt sparks major debate over safety risks

Airlink insists flyby conducted according to regulations

A pre-game stunt involving two passenger jets flying dramatically low over a stadium in South Africa drew huge cheers from the estimated crowd of 56,000 people, but also sparked a major debate over safety risks. The flyby by two Embraer jets, operated by the local airline Airlink, happened on Saturday before the second rugby union Test between South Africa and New Zealand in Cape Town.
The flight tracking service Flightradar24 estimated that the lead jet passed just 41-46 feet (12-14 metres) above the roof of Cape Town Stadium, with the crowd and the world’s top-ranked rugby teams below. The second jet, which was very close behind, flew through a cloud of pink dust that shot up from the stadium roof as part of the show.

articles.title: Amid political and economic pressure, Brazil sees a rise in land conflicts and the murders of Indigenous people

articles.title: ‘The Sigh of the Earth’: Fragments from communities overlooked after Venezuela’s earthquakes

articles.titleJa: 「大地の嘆き」：ベネズエラの地震後、見過ごされたコミュニティからの断片

articles.title: More than a month after Venezuela’s earthquakes: ‘I’m not leaving here until my son is found’

articles.title: In Brazil, court ruling sheds light on the story of an undocumented and stateless woman

articles.title: Venezuela is burning, and I’m forced to watch from afar

articles.title: How much will it take to rebuild Venezuela after the earthquakes?

articles.title: From Mexico to Venezuela: A diaspora’s race to save lives

articles.title: How an AI research tool helped challenge support for police violence in Brazil

articles.title: 'Like fighting a dinosaur': Sydney woman recalls how she punched shark during attack

articles.title: Public Forum 2026 programme is now available
articles.description: This year’s Public Forum, entitled Powering the Future, will feature 113 sessions – with a focus on trade in services – from 15 to 17 September. Sessions are organized by WTO member governments, businesses, non-governmental organizations, academia and international organizations, with many sessions livestreamed on the WTO website.
articles.titleJa: 公開フォーラム2026のプログラムが公開されました
articles.summary: 「未来を動かす力」と題された2026年公開フォーラムのプログラムが発表された。9月15日から17日まで開催され、サービス貿易に焦点を当てた113のセッションが予定されている。

articles.title: WTO members adopt panel report regarding EU duties on fatty acid from Indonesia
articles.description: At a meeting on 28 August of the Dispute Settlement Body (DSB), WTO members adopted a panel report regarding the European Union’s anti-dumping duties on imports of fatty acid from Indonesia.

articles.title: Madagascar launches safeguard investigation on self-adhesive labels, packaging and certain other printed items
articles.description: On 28 August 2026, Madagascar notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated on 13 August 2026 a safeguard investigation on imports of self-adhesive labels, packaging and other printed items on paper, cardboard, plastics, textiles or other similar materials.
articles.titleJa: マダガスカル、粘着ラベル、包装材、その他一部の印刷物に関するセーフガード調査を開始

articles.title: Deadline to register for 2026 Public Forum is 21 August
articles.description: The deadline for online registration for this year’s in-person Public Forum, which will take place on 15, 16 and 17 September, is 21 August 2026 (23.59 CET). Late and onsite registrations will not be accepted.
articles.titleJa: 2026年公開フォーラムの登録締め切りは8月21日
articles.summary: 9月15日から17日まで開催される対面式公開フォーラムのオンライン登録締め切りは、2026年8月21日（中央ヨーロッパ時間23時59分）である。

articles.title: United Kingdom launches safeguard investigation on polyethylene terephthalate

articles.titleJa: 英国、ポリエチレンテレフタレートに関するセーフガード調査を開始
articles.summary: 英国は、特定のポリエチレンテレフタレート（PET）の輸入に対するセーフガード調査を開始したことをWTOに通知した。

articles.title: World Trade and Tech Day to explore policies to make AI work for inclusive trade
articles.description: The WTO will host the first World Trade and Tech Day on 14 September at its headquarters in Geneva, bringing together trade and information and communications technology (ICT) policymakers, industry leaders and other stakeholders to discuss how artificial intelligence (AI) strategies can better support economies' efforts to maximize the gains of international trade.
articles.titleJa: 世界貿易技術デー、AIを包摂的貿易に活用する政策を検討へ
articles.summary: WTOはジュネーブ本部で初の「世界貿易技術デー」を開催し、AI戦略がいかに国際貿易の利益を最大化できるかについて議論する。

articles.title: Global goods trade resilient in the first quarter of 2026 despite war in Middle East
articles.description: World merchandise trade growth exceeded expectations in the first quarter of 2026 as surging trade in electronic components related to artificial intelligence (AI) offset the negative impact of the conflict in the Middle East, which began in the final month of the quarter. Trade disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz are expected to be more fully captured in trade data for the next quarter.
articles.titleJa: 2026年第1四半期、中東紛争にもかかわらず世界の物品貿易は回復力を見せる
articles.summary: 2026年第1四半期の世界の物品貿易は、AI関連電子部品の貿易急増により、中東紛争の悪影響を相殺し、予想を上回る成長を見せた。

articles.title: Brazil initiates dispute regarding additional duties imposed by the United States
articles.description: Brazil has requested WTO dispute consultations with the United States regarding additional US duties on products originating in Brazil as a result of two investigations by the United States under Section 301 of the US Trade Act of 1974. Brazil said the additional duties are above the duties otherwise applicable under the US harmonized tariff schedule. The request was circulated to WTO members on 30 July.
articles.titleJa: ブラジル、米国が課した追加関税に関して紛争提起
articles.summary: ブラジルは、米国が1974年通商法301条に基づきブラジル製品に課した追加関税について、WTO紛争協議を要請した。

articles.title: WTO panel issues report regarding Turkish measures on EVs and other types of vehicles
articles.description: On 28 July, the WTO circulated the panel report in the case brought by China in "Türkiye — Measures Concerning Electric Vehicles and Other Types of Vehicles from China" (DS629).
articles.titleJa: WTOパネル、トルコによるEVなどの車両に関する措置について報告書を発行
articles.summary: WTOは、中国が提起した「トルコ—中国製電気自動車およびその他車両に関する措置」に関するパネル報告書を回覧した。

articles.title: Lithuania gives EUR 30,000 to help developing economies and LDCs improve trade skillset
articles.description: Lithuania is contributing EUR 30,000 (approximately CHF 28,000) in 2026 to finance training programmes for government officials from developing economies, including least-developed countries (LDCs). This contribution to the WTO Global Trust Fund will support these economies in deepening their expertise on WTO issues and help them participate more effectively in the rules-based multilateral trading system.
articles.titleJa: リトアニア、発展途上国および後発開発途上国の貿易スキル向上支援に3万ユーロを拠出
articles.summary: リトアニアは、発展途上国および後発開発途上国の政府関係者向け研修プログラム資金として、WTOグローバル信託基金に3万ユーロを拠出した。
